description: Random triples around the daily cap (review of the audit 33f3b9f fixes, defect 1), every amount on the 6 decimal grid and at most 1e9 FLOP. Each entry is [cap, spent, charge, over, left, room]. over is decided in integers: the charge is above cap - spent in millionths. left is cap - spent - charge and room is cap - spent, both exact. imd-flop (checkBudget, roomLeft) and the viewer (spend_limit, limit_flags) must give these on every one, so they agree on every one. Generated once with a seeded Python PRNG; most charges are within 3 millionths of the room.
